expectedLearning: Whether exact partition refinement and contributor lineage can synchronize symbolic and concrete views without representation-owned math.
Whether existing canonical motion, clock, layout, host, Review, and promotion seams amortize a new multi-view exemplar without new runtime categories.
Whether typed completeness and evidence-derived promotion prevent missing views, identity fades, and false ported status.
allowedWork: One exact rational quantity, unit, partition, selection, and provenance model.
One verified five-beat trace with immutable evaluation and four synchronized view projections.
Existing canonical animation, correspondence, clock, reader, responsive, static, accessibility, export, Animation Library, Review, and promotion seams.
Bounded generic contracts proven necessary by the exemplar and stable repository-owned checks.
disallowedWork: No second renderer session, compositor, runtime, clock, scheduler, paint authority, display page, or WebGL lease.
No renderer-owned arithmetic, representation-specific semantic exception, glyph inference, or whole-scene fade replacement.
No fraction-family rollout, later promotions, problem-generator bridge, LLM editorial integration, universal motif registry, or detached cleanup.
No overwrite of unrelated user-owned dirty files.
goal: Promote one canonical exact-quantity animation for 1/3 + 1/6 = 1/2 across native KaTeX, partitioned circles, fraction bars or area, and a number line, stopping for human visual review before release.
commitCadence: Commit after each completed and proportionately verified slice; keep control, semantic, projection, product, checkpoint, repair, and release rollback units independently revertible.
stopConditions: Stop if exact value, unit identity, selected-part provenance, contributor lineage, fold truth, accessibility, export truth, or settled native authority changes.
Stop if a visual projection becomes mathematical authority or persistent, fission, or fusion identity falls back to generic opacity.
Stop if implementation requires a new clock, runtime, scheduler category, equation compositor, WebGL lease, display page, or representation-specific semantic exception.
Stop if a certificate can be forged, a required view can be omitted, promotion can be claimed by an authorable flag, or another canonical reader regresses.
Stop at slice 23 for explicit human visual approval before slices 24 and 25.
Stop if unrelated user-owned dirty files must be overwritten.

slices.title: materialize-approved-contract
slices.summary: Materialized the approved contract and linked the active exact-fraction promotion phase to its execution authority.

slices.title: reconcile-stale-frontier
slices.summary: Activated warning-free plan revision 13. Reconciled the never-executed duplicate convergence scaffold as skipped history, linked completed radical and quadratic evidence to their terminal authorities, linked this run to exact-fraction-quantity-models, and preserved the stable content-led promotion order plus platform gates.

slices.title: add-promotion-drift-gate
slices.summary: Added a repository-owned promotion-memory gate that parses the sole stable ledger, derives the first unresolved rank, checks the roadmap and current queue, requires one matching active Theseus phase and live run, and makes a promoted claim fail unless its catalog animation ID is evidence-derived as ported. Updated the living pointers to the active exact-fraction run without duplicating the rank table.

slices.title: freeze-exemplar-reference
slices.summary: Froze the exact 1/3 + 1/6 = 1/2 reference as five ordered checkpoints and pacing beats over one shared unit and six stable atomic parts. Required symbolic, circle, bar, and number-line views; preserved fold, accessibility, and architecture truth; and explicitly forbade renderer arithmetic, geometry/DOM/color identity, opacity handoffs, new display pages, runtime categories, and resource growth.

slices.title: add-exact-quantity-core
slices.summary: Extracted the linear provider's bigint rational laws into one immutable domain-neutral core while leaving DTO and solver policy in the provider. Added nominal exact-quantity units and a proof-carrying sum constructor: NoInfer rejects authored cross-unit addition at typecheck, and an explicit runtime identity guard rejects widened or decoded mismatches before a certificate can exist.

slices.title: model-finite-partitions
slices.summary: Added a geometry-free finite-partition domain model with exact positive measures totaling one, deterministic branded part IDs, contiguous logical ordinals, immutable partition-scoped selections, and exact derived quantities. Duplicate IDs, ordinal gaps, bad totals, repeated selections, missing parts, and cross-partition authored IDs all fail before projection.

slices.title: certify-refine-and-merge
slices.summary: Added module-sealed certificates for whole-partition refinement, selected refinement, disjoint selection fusion, and equivalent regrouping. Every cohort proves exact measure and exhaustive non-duplicated source/target lineage, classifies persist/fission/fusion/regroup, supports inverse regrouping, and rejects incomplete, overlapping, mismatched, or structurally forged witnesses.

slices.title: build-five-beat-trace
slices.summary: Built one immutable five-state/five-beat trace for establish, refine, align, merge, and recognize. It owns explicit 1/3 to 2/6 equivalence, 2/6 + 1/6 alignment, 3/6 fusion, and 1/2 regrouping through sealed exact proofs; every state totals one half, dependencies are sequential, sixth-atom provenance closes, and serialization is deterministic and renderer-neutral.

slices.title: type-view-obligations
slices.summary: Projected the trace into one immutable evaluation tree with two disclosure groups and exact forward/rewind order. Expanded, collapsed, automatic, and pinned projections carry identical state, checkpoint, beat, unit, and final-equality truth. Added a sealed mapped-type view bundle requiring all four named projections with exact trace/selection identity and nonempty accessible summaries; missing or forged bundles fail closed.

slices.title: sample-neutral-frames
slices.summary: Added a pure canonical-progress sampler producing immutable representation-neutral frames with beat-local progress, exact source/target states, symbolic forms, selections, sixth atoms, focus, and persist/fission/fusion cohorts. Forward and rewind share the same absolute semantic coordinate, repeated direct seeks are history-independent, and checkpoint progress now exactly equals each frozen pacing beat's settled endpoint rather than an intermediate frame.

slices.title: compile-symbolic-projection
slices.summary: Compiled all five certified states to trace-derived native KaTeX endpoints with parallel static MathML. Every paint selector and fraction rule participates exactly once in explicit persistence or fusion input; rational values come only from the verified trace, and the projection introduces no sanitizer, geometry, typography, opacity, clock, or lifecycle authority.

slices.title: project-partitioned-circles
slices.summary: Added a deterministic partitioned-circle projection over the canonical neutral frame. Six stable sector IDs map directly to sixth atoms; exact coverage and selected area remain rational facts, contributor and lifecycle mappings come from the trace, refinement exposes a one-third source cohort and two target sectors without opacity, and SVG geometry cannot authorize or reorder semantic identity.

slices.title: project-fraction-bars
slices.summary: Added a responsive intrinsic fraction-bar projection with six exact extents, deterministic SVG, and explicit third-to-two-sixths divider refinement. Extracted one documented atomic projection joint now used by both circles and bars, so selected state, contributor IDs, and persist/fission/fusion lifecycles cannot drift between concrete views or be inferred from geometry.

slices.title: project-number-line
slices.summary: Added a deterministic number-line projection from the shared atomic view joint. Seven exact rational ticks and six named intervals precede pixel layout; contributor spans explicitly compose adjacent one-third and one-sixth intervals to the exact half endpoint. Rendering is responsive, direction-independent SVG, and neither coordinates nor DOM order can become mathematical authority.

slices.title: compose-cross-view-identity
slices.summary: Composed the four projections into one module-sealed synchronized frame. Every sixth atom and target selection names explicit symbolic selectors, circle sectors, bar parts, number-line intervals, focus state, and transcript references. A mapped four-view obligation is certified from the trace, while trace/frame/total mismatch, missing or duplicate identities, and cross-view lifecycle disagreement fail closed without color or spatial fallback.

slices.title: bind-quantity-motifs
slices.summary: Bound every semantic beat to existing core presentation operations: focus, fan-out, group, merge, and persist. Added only two exemplar-proven motif payloads—partition refinement and part merge—both backed by the existing fission/fusion plan and shared canonical beat scheduler. Typed paint bindings admit only opacity 1 and existing persist/fission/fusion lifecycles, with continuous or atomic exclusive ownership rather than fades.

slices.title: integrate-shared-runtime
slices.summary: Integrated trace, symbolic endpoints, motif plan, and all four views through one sealed runtime session consuming the existing shared animation clock. Absolute progress is the sole visual coordinate; direction remains control intent, so forward and rewind frames are identical. Each view has exactly one native or transient paint owner, all settled checkpoints reuse native endpoint geometry, and motif local progress receives one easing application without history or a second renderer.

slices.title: certify-responsive-layout
slices.summary: Added a sealed responsive layout projection: a centered two-by-two readable grid at wide widths and one deterministic active representation on phones. All required views remain present, focus identity survives switching, intrinsic content is contained at unit scale above the 18px floor, DPR and resize produce explicit measurement invalidation keys, and the validator rejects overlap, clipping, arbitrary wrap, or emergency shrink-to-fit.

slices.title: register-animation-library
slices.summary: Registered one reviewable exact-quantity asset in the existing Animation Library through its own literal lazy capability pack. The shared player owns play, seek, step, and rewind; typed exemplar controls add manifest checkpoint starts, active phone representation, evaluation folds, and pins with permille URL round-trip. One high-priority diagram adapter renders all four synchronized views, delegates symbolic motion to the shared canonical native-KaTeX scene session, uses existing fission/fusion sampling for opaque concrete parts, and adds no route, HTML display page, eager main import, compatibility paint, clock, runtime, or ported claim.

slices.title: wire-review-capture
slices.summary: Mounted the existing Review composer on the direct single-page Animation Library through one DEV-only provider and one shared lifecycle slot. Each immutable capture now saves canonical animation identity, exact progress, phase-local progress, phase, checkpoint, active representation, fold mode and pins, focus refs, direction, renderer owners, wide/phone profile, shell/content/stage dimensions, and DPR with its comment; phone and wide browser tests prove schema round-trip, real inbox query visibility, reachability, and post-capture mutation isolation. Extracted one cross-layer layout policy and moved renderer-composing runtime out of the neutral animation layer so architecture gates pass without duplicate breakpoint or view authority; production closure proves the Review graph is erased.

slices.title: preserve-accessibility-export
slices.summary: Preserved the exact five-beat causal story through one trace-derived screen-reader projection, one fold- and view-invariant transcript, keyboard-visible focus/current state, and settled reduced/static/narrated checkpoints. Added a renderable five-step static export with native symbolic HTML and MathML plus deterministic circle, bar, and number-line SVG descriptions. Visual replicas are aria-hidden, no operation exists only in motion, and no fold or active representation can alter exported or accessible truth.

slices.title: prove-browser-determinism
slices.summary: Added stable exact unit, full browser, and three-browser visual entrypoints. Dense boundary, reverse, random revisit, resize, DPR2, font, accessibility, performance, resource, and disposal checks prove deterministic history-independent behavior in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. The audit found and repaired a real align-sixths compositor failure: authored fraction envelopes now form a typed presentation merge cohort, and the generic fan-in planner searches bounded measured lanes above or below while keeping related structural paint together. Shared player disposal now explicitly releases surface-owned sessions; the exemplar reuses identical frames, exposes bounded telemetry, owns at most one symbolic session, and acquires no WebGL lease.
